title: Kissed Lo Mein
description: A simple Chinese-inspired dish made with lo mein noodles, vegetables, and a sweet and savory sauce.

ingredients.name: Vegetables (such as cabbage, carrots, and bell peppers)

instructions: Cook the lo mein noodles according to package instructions.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add the caraway.
Add the sliced vegetables and cook until they are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Chinese Kissed sauce and 1 tablespoon of water.
Add the sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with sesame seeds if desired.
